purpose: Art direction reference; not a runtime sprite
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create a NEW professional character art-direction sheet for the Horizons language-learning app, using the supplied image only as STYLE REFERENCE. Four columns and two rows, eight separate fully connected designs on a plain white background. No labels or text. Match the reference's bold, witty, confident GEOMETRIC flat cartoon language: distinctive silhouettes, adult-friendly proportions, angular/rounded-rectangle faces, strong simple noses and expressive eyebrows, SMALL white eye shapes with black pupils. Clean simple hands, graphic clothing, saturated color blocks. NOT generic cutesy preschool figures, NOT baby heads, NOT big circular heads with tiny dot-smiles, NOT inflated/puffy/3D illustration. Every shape is an opaque uniform color. NO SHADOWS, NO gradients, highlights, texture, lighting, soft shading, ground shadows, strokes or outlines.
TOP ROW four full-body original companions, each comfortably inside its own column:
1 Pico, an adventurous cream mountain hare. Tall graphic ears, one straight and one bent; long compact softly rectangular hare muzzle, small expressive white eyes, asymmetrical brow, broad simple feet, slim torso, magenta diagonal satchel with orange button. Clearly a hare, not a toy baby rabbit. Cheerful open mouth; hand on hip.
2 Mina, a tall slim adult woman in her late twenties, warm peach skin, angular medium-length dark auburn side-swept hair, softly trapezoid face, prominent angular nose, expressive brows, small white eyes. Magenta open jacket over pale cream shirt, narrow navy trousers, orange flat shoes. One elbow bent with friendly open palm.
3 Alex, a shorter broad-shouldered adult man in his twenties, rich brown skin, short blocky curls, rounded-rectangle face with broad nose and strong eyebrows, small white eyes. Teal casual jacket, orange shirt, slate navy trousers, cream shoes, simple navy headphones around neck. Confident relaxed stance, one forearm out.
4 Jo, a stocky older adult woman in her fifties, warm medium-brown skin, compact graphic grey bob, soft-square face, long simple nose, cheerful brows behind small navy glasses. Orange shirt and broad navy café apron, olive trousers, cream shoes. Holds a small teal mug with the supporting hand directly touching it.
BOTTOM ROW four fully clothed UPPER-CHEST BUST avatar design examples. Genuinely adult facial proportions: head width about two thirds of shoulder width, visible natural neck, small eyes, expressive nose/brows, varied jaw shapes. Same geometric illustration system as the top row. Distinct hairstyles and accessories: navy quiff with bold glasses and teal jacket; auburn asymmetric bob with a vivid magenta scarf; short black curls with orange beanie and navy hoodie; long blonde angular hair with teal headphones and orange sweater. Include varied skin tones. Friendly and stylish for all ages, not childlike dolls. Broad shoulder silhouettes, crisp simple clothes, and clear faces. These are original Horizons designs inspired by the supplied graphic language; do not reproduce the reference's characters. Emphasize designed personality and asymmetry rather than soft circular generic faces.
productionConstraint: Use geometric silhouettes and expression only. Omit directional side-plane shading, dark neck triangles, gradients and cast shadows from production sprites.
